en.ammaar-muslim: [2/1547] al-Kafi: Humayd b. Ziyad from Muhammad b. Sama’a; A number of our companions from Ahmad b. Muhammad; all together from Muhsin b. Ahmad from Aban b. Uthman from Ibn Abi Ya’fur who said:

I heard Aba Abdillah (AS) saying: A man -if he used to know a chapter and then forgets it or abandons it and then enters paradise- she appears to him from above in a most beautiful form and says: ‘Do you know me?’ He says: ‘No’ She says: ‘I am such and such chapter, you did not act by me and abandoned me, by Allah if you had acted by me I would have made you reach this station,’ and she points with her hand above her
